title: lore agents --check mislabels an absent, correctly-orphaned SKILL.md as up-to-date
description: Found by opum-agent running the skill_source=plugin dogfood cycle on itself with 0.4.3, and independently noticed (but not acted on) during LCLI-444's own dogfood on lore-cli. Under [agents].skill_source = "plugin", once a leftover SKILL.md has been removed (by --force or by hand), a subsequent lore agents --check prints 'up-to-date .claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md' and exits 0. Exit 0 is correct (absence is the correct state under plugin mode -- action is genuinely 'unchanged'), but the label is misleading: it names a file that config says must not exist and that is in fact absent, phrased as if it were a maintained target that happens to match. actionLabel()/plainActionLabel() in src/commands/agents.ts fall through to the generic 'unchanged' -> 'up to date' rendering for this case with no skill_source-aware branch. Fix: either omit the SKILL.md row entirely from --check output when skillSource is 'plugin' and the file is absent, or render a distinct label such as 'absent (skill from plugin)' instead of 'up to date'.

acceptanceCriteria.text: under skill_source=plugin with no SKILL.md on disk, lore agents --check either omits the SKILL.md row or renders a label that does not say up-to-date/unchanged for a file that must not exist
the exit code stays 0 for this case (unchanged from today)
existing behavior for skill_source=repo (or unset) is byte-for-byte unchanged
a test pins the new label/omission and a regression test pins the unchanged default case

finalSummary: actionLabel()/plainActionLabel() in src/commands/agents.ts now take (path, action, check, skillSource) instead of (action, check), and check for the specific reachable-only-when-absent case: SKILL_REL_PATH + action=unchanged + skillSource=plugin (planSkill in agent-bridge.ts never returns unchanged for a PRESENT file under plugin mode, only orphaned/removed -- so unchanged there always means correctly-absent). Renders 'correctly absent (skill source: plugin)' in pretty mode, 'absent (skill source: plugin)' for the plain non-check trailer-adjacent label, and the plain-mode token 'absent-plugin-sourced'. AgentsResult gained a skillSource field (populated from applyAgentsBridge's already-resolved value) to make this possible without re-deriving config at render time. Exit code unchanged (0), skillSource=repo (default) behavior byte-for-byte unchanged -- verified by a regression test asserting the pre-existing 'up-to-date' label still appears for a matching SKILL.md under the default source. 2 new tests in test/agents.test.ts (the new label in both plain and pretty modes, non-check mode too; the regression guard). Full suite 2857 pass/1 skip/0 fail, typecheck clean, lint clean, lore check 77 files/0 errors. CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] entry added.
